company.name: STON.fi
company.shortDescription: STON.fi is a decentralized TON platform delivering secure swaps, farming rewards, and efficient crypto trading solutions.
company.description: STON.fi is the leading DEX and a suite of swap-enabling protocols on TON blockchain, recognized for its high token variety, deep liquidity, and dominance in total value locked (TVL) and trading volume. STON.fi integrates with TON wallets, supports all TON-based tokens, and enables token swaps, liquidity provision, staking, and yield farming.
